articles.title: Dam fails in northern Varnia
sentences: A dam in northern Varnia failed on Tuesday night.
Officials said 12 people were killed in the flood.
Rescue teams searched the valley for survivors.
Heavy rain had fallen across the region for a week.
The government declared a state of emergency.

articles.title: Death toll rises after dam failure
sentences: The death toll from the dam failure has risen to 31 people, officials said.
Another 40 people are still missing, local police said.
Hundreds of homes were destroyed by the water.
Engineers said the dam was built decades ago.
Residents were moved to shelters in nearby towns.
The prime minister visited the area on Wednesday.

articles.title: Inquiry opens into dam collapse
sentences: An inquiry into the dam collapse opened on Thursday.
Investigators found cracks in the structure two years ago.
The interior ministry said 57 people died in total.
Opposition leaders demanded the minister resign.
A memorial service is planned for Sunday.

articles.title: Dam maintenance records
sentences: Maintenance crews first patched spillway cracks across 2014 summer.
Budget cuts later halted further inspections.
Local farmers rely on the reservoir for irrigation.
